## Child components

- **`eg.wire-contracts`** (layer: types, status: proposed) — The zero- and one-edge contract leaves every other component imports. eg-types is the BOTTOM of the DAG and the only crate the whole workspace can see: protocol.rs (Request/Response/Method/ResultPayload), types.rs, wire.rs, acl.rs and the MutationBatch v1 contract itself (mutation_batch/, incl. MutationScope, MutationScopeIdentity, PRIVATE_PAYLOAD_EVENT_TYPES, COMPILED_BATCH_INCARNATION and the three domain predicates). eg-capabilities is the machine-checked MethodPolicy projection of eg_types::protocol::Method (deps = eg-types only). eg-durable carries routing contracts only (CallShape/WorkShape/DurableBackendKind) with no journal, lease or 2PC. eg-resource is dependency-free cgroup-aware capacity resolution. Grouped as one seam because all four are contract-only, are consumed workspace-wide, and splitting them would produce exactly the tiny-facade pattern the layout contract forbids. ADDED 2026-09-12 (F5): the RF-020 Agent Library identity contract also lives here, still within the existing `crates/eg-types/src/` root -- `agent_library.rs` (`AgentLibraryEntry`, `AgentLibraryLifecycle`, the schema-versioned definition/tool-surface digest domains, currently v5), `agent_component.rs`, `agent_graph.rs`, and `agent_template.rs`. This was UNCLAIMED as recently as the 5523859a/2026-09-04 verification; see `capability_authority_model.previously_unclaimed_now_claimed` for the correction record.
- **`eg.mutation-store`** (layer: types, status: proposed) — RF-RULING-004's two dependency-ordered authorities, formerly one crate (eg-mutation-store, retired 2026-09-06 -- see migration_lineage). eg-transaction ("Sole mutation authority: admission, ordering, fencing, commit, replay identity, outbox, and consensus-transaction intent records") is MutationKernelV1: ledger.rs, admission.rs, commit.rs, saga.rs, replay.rs, the participant/ consensus-transaction intent codec, and its own src/tests/ integration suite. eg-storage ("Sole physical-state authority: durable opens, owner-table registry, scoped capabilities, snapshots, backup/restore/adoption, recovery validation") is StorageKernelV1: the owner/ registry, physical/ manifest+incarnation, recovery/ adopt+backup+validate, and direct_state/ journal. eg-transaction depends on eg-storage (StorageKernelV1 hands MutationKernelV1 write authority via a move-once MutationOwnerAuthority); eg-storage names no eg-transaction edge, so the physical-state kernel can never depend inward on its mutation-authority consumer. Kept as ONE registry component (see migration_lineage) because both crates implement exactly the five capability_ids this component already owned before the split -- no capability moved, gained, or was lost. Still placed under target layer `types`, NOT `storage-transaction`, for the same cyclicity reason as before the split: eg-core (layer `core`) depends on both crates.
- **`eg.modality`** (layer: types, status: proposed) — The ModalityContract seam and every crate that converges on it. eg-modality owns the trait + conformance harness (TCK) and deliberately sits BELOW eg-plan/eg-core with deps = eg-types only. The leaves own governed pure-Rust decode + evidence: PCM/WAV, PNG + pHash, ISOBMFF + RGB frames, typed document pages/layout/tables, WKT geometry + an in-house packed Hilbert R-tree (no GEOS/PROJ), a Tantivy BM25 inverted index, a bounded-NFA CEP engine, and the shared alignment graph over EvidenceLocus. eg-tensor is owned here as the dense N-D array modality but carries a declared layer violation (see D-EG-002): its edge to eg-tsdb is mandatory while its edge to eg-modality is OPTIONAL behind the `contract` feature.
- **`eg.numeric-ann`** (layer: types, status: proposed) — The slim BLAS/LAPACK-free numeric kernel (ndarray + nalgebra; one kernel, two surfaces) and the native IVF-PQ + OPQ + SQ8-refine ANN index built on it. Kept as one seam because eg-ann is the only in-workspace consumer of eg-numeric's kernel surface besides the quantum stack, and both are pure numeric leaves with no store or policy authority.
- **`eg.lm-program`** (layer: types, status: proposed) — Graph-native governed LM-program and self-improvement contracts (deps = eg-modality, eg-types). Contract-only; wired into the facade behind the root `program-optimization` feature. Model- and vendor-agnostic by construction, per the layout contract's prohibition on vendor labels in ownership identity.
- **`eg.speech-providers`** (layer: types, status: proposed) — Provider implementations of the frozen `asr.*` and `tts.*` contracts eg-audio declares. They are the only crates in the workspace that compile a vendored C/C++ library (whisper.cpp/ggml via whisper-rs-sys), which is why the repo's CPU-portability contract (GGML_NATIVE=OFF and the explicit GGML_BMI2=OFF in .cargo/config.toml) exists; the fleet's hosts are pre-AVX2. Providers never decide policy and never own a mutation scope.
